# =====================================================================
# Sefer redesign effects (2026-11-08). Design:
# docs/spec/2026-11-08-sefer-system-redesign.md (with Daniel's decisions at
# its head); build record: docs/implementation/2026-11-08-sefer-redesign-
# build.md. Per-work effects are generated by scripts/kehillah_library_
# catalog.py into kehillah_library_study_generated_effects.txt and are
# reached here through $KEY$ (a work id without the flag: prefix).
# =====================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. The library registry (spec section 2)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

# Scope: a landed title holding (or about to hold) a collection. Adds it
# to kehillah_libraries, records its seat and tradition, and makes sure
# the Tanakh is on its shelf.
kehillah_lib_register_library_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_libraries target = this } } }
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_libraries target = this }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_library_tradition } }
		if = {
			limit = { holder ?= { faith = faith:haymanot } }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_library_tradition value = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { holder ?= { kehillah_is_karaite_character_trigger = yes } }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_library_tradition value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { holder ?= { rite = rite:minhag_yerushalmi } }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_library_tradition value = 4 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_library_tradition value = 1 }
		}
	}
	kehillah_lib_refresh_seat_effect = yes
	kehillah_lib_seed_tanakh_effect = yes
	kehillah_lib_refresh_cache_effect = yes
	kehillah_lib_refresh_readers_effect = yes
	# 2026-11-08: a Beit Midrash links its county to its card.
	kehillah_lib_link_card_county_effect = yes
}

# Scope: a library. The represented community follows its living leader's
# current Jewish rite, so a conversion changes the library's canon identity
# on its next yearly refresh without deleting manuscripts already acquired.
kehillah_lib_refresh_tradition_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { holder ?= { faith = faith:haymanot } }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_library_tradition value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { holder ?= { kehillah_is_karaite_character_trigger = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_library_tradition value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { holder ?= { faith.religion = religion:judaism_religion rite = rite:minhag_yerushalmi } }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_library_tradition value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { holder ?= { faith.religion = religion:judaism_religion } }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_library_tradition value = 1 }
	}
}

# Scope: a library title. Its holder, and a landed holder's Jewish lieges,
# learn that they read here (var:kehillah_own_library).
kehillah_lib_refresh_readers_effect = {
	holder ?= {
		kehillah_lib_refresh_own_library_effect = yes
		every_liege_or_above = {
			limit = { kehillah_is_jewish_landed_ruler_trigger = yes }
			kehillah_lib_refresh_own_library_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

# Scope: a library title (yearly). A Kehillah's V29 yeshiva needs a
# complete Shas too: five years without one leave it dormant. Yeshivot that
# existed before this rule are grandfathered (kehillah_yeshiva_
# grandfathered, set by the migration).
kehillah_lib_kehillah_yeshiva_shas_check_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { tier = tier_barony }
			holder ?= { kehillah_has_yeshiva_trigger = yes }
			NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_yeshiva_grandfathered }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_yeshiva_shasless_years } }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_yeshiva_shasless_years value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_lib_foundations_complete_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_yeshiva_shasless_years value = 0 }
			remove_variable = kehillah_yeshiva_dormant
		}
		else = {
			change_variable = { name = kehillah_yeshiva_shasless_years add = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:kehillah_yeshiva_shasless_years >= 5 }
				set_variable = { name = kehillah_yeshiva_dormant value = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Scope: a library title. Its seat: a barony's own province, or a
# Kehillah's domicile.
kehillah_lib_refresh_seat_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tier = tier_barony }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_library_seat value = title_province }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { holder ?= { exists = domicile } }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_library_seat value = holder.domicile.domicile_location }
	}
}

# Scope: a library title. Every Jewish library holds the Tanakh; if it is
# ever lost it returns at the next yearly pass (spec section 5.1).
kehillah_lib_seed_tanakh_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_torah } } }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_torah }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { kehillah_lib_is_haymanot_library_trigger = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_neviim } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_neviim }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_ketuvim } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_ketuvim }
		}
	}
}

# Scope: a library title. Caches what the Greatness row and the map read.
kehillah_lib_refresh_cache_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_is_haymanot_library_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_foundation_missing value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_is_karaite_library_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_foundation_missing value = kehillah_lib_karaite_missing_count_value }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_foundation_missing value = kehillah_lib_bavli_missing_count_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_lib_foundation_missing <= 0 NOT = { kehillah_lib_is_haymanot_library_trigger = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_shas_complete value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = kehillah_lib_shas_complete }
		remove_variable = kehillah_lib_shas_complete
	}
}

# Scope: a character. Which library he reads at home: his Kehillah's, a
# library barony he holds, or one held by a Jewish vassal in his realm.
kehillah_lib_refresh_own_library_effect = {
	save_scope_as = kehillah_own_lib_owner
	if = {
		limit = {
			government_has_flag = government_is_kehillah
			exists = primary_title
		}
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_own_library value = primary_title }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			kehillah_is_jewish_landed_ruler_trigger = yes
			any_held_title = {
				kehillah_lib_is_library_title_trigger = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_library_sealed }
			}
		}
		random_held_title = {
			limit = {
				kehillah_lib_is_library_title_trigger = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_library_sealed }
			}
			scope:kehillah_own_lib_owner = { set_variable = { name = kehillah_own_library value = prev } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			kehillah_is_jewish_landed_ruler_trigger = yes
			any_in_global_list = {
				variable = kehillah_libraries
				exists = holder
				NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_library_sealed }
				holder = { any_liege_or_above = { this = scope:kehillah_own_lib_owner } }
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = kehillah_libraries
			limit = {
				exists = holder
				NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_library_sealed }
				holder = { any_liege_or_above = { this = scope:kehillah_own_lib_owner } }
			}
			scope:kehillah_own_lib_owner = { set_variable = { name = kehillah_own_library value = prev } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = kehillah_own_library }
		remove_variable = kehillah_own_library
	}
}

# Scope: a character. Refresh, then save the library as
# scope:kehillah_own_library_scope (unset when he has none).
kehillah_lib_resolve_own_library_effect = {
	kehillah_lib_refresh_own_library_effect = yes
	var:kehillah_own_library ?= { save_scope_as = kehillah_own_library_scope }
}

# Scope: a library title. Sealed when a non-Jewish lord takes a library
# barony (spec section 2.4). The new holder decides what becomes of it.
kehillah_lib_seal_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_library_sealed value = yes }
	save_scope_as = kehillah_sealed_library
	holder = { trigger_event = kehillah_sefer.0020 }
}

# Scope: a library title. Once a year.
kehillah_lib_yearly_library_effect = {
	kehillah_lib_refresh_tradition_effect = yes
	# Correct the default six-work Rabbanite seed in older Haymanot saves.
	# A changed shelf is left intact so acquired works are never deleted.
	if = {
		limit = { holder ?= { faith = faith:haymanot } NOT = { kehillah_lib_is_haymanot_library_trigger = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				kehillah_lib_work_count_value = 6
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_torah }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_neviim }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_ketuvim }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mishnah }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_bavli_moed }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_bavli_nashim }
			}
			remove_list_variable = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_neviim }
			remove_list_variable = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_ketuvim }
			remove_list_variable = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mishnah }
			remove_list_variable = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_bavli_moed }
			remove_list_variable = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_bavli_nashim }
		}
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_library_tradition value = 3 }
	}
	kehillah_lib_refresh_seat_effect = yes
	kehillah_lib_seed_tanakh_effect = yes
	kehillah_lib_refresh_cache_effect = yes
	kehillah_lib_refresh_readers_effect = yes
	kehillah_landed_yeshiva_yearly_effect = yes
	kehillah_lib_kehillah_yeshiva_shas_check_effect = yes
	# Sealing and unsealing of a landed library.
	if = {
		limit = {
			tier = tier_barony
			NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_library_sealed }
			holder = { NOT = { faith.religion = religion:judaism_religion } }
		}
		kehillah_lib_seal_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = kehillah_library_sealed
			holder = { faith.religion = religion:judaism_religion }
		}
		remove_variable = kehillah_library_sealed
	}
	# A complete Shas (or a Karaite library's complete foundations) honours
	# the library's holder (spec section 5.2).
	holder = { remove_character_modifier = kehillah_complete_shas_modifier }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = kehillah_lib_shas_complete }
		holder = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = kehillah_complete_shas_modifier years = 1 } }
	}
	# Banned works: Piety for the holder, fame for the yeshiva.
	kehillah_lib_count_banned_effect = yes
	save_scope_as = kehillah_banned_library
	holder = {
		remove_character_modifier = kehillah_banned_books_1_modifier
		remove_character_modifier = kehillah_banned_books_2_modifier
		remove_character_modifier = kehillah_banned_books_3_modifier
		if = {
			limit = { scope:kehillah_banned_library.var:kehillah_lib_banned_count >= 3 }
			add_character_modifier = { modifier = kehillah_banned_books_3_modifier years = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:kehillah_banned_library.var:kehillah_lib_banned_count = 2 }
			add_character_modifier = { modifier = kehillah_banned_books_2_modifier years = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:kehillah_banned_library.var:kehillah_lib_banned_count = 1 }
			add_character_modifier = { modifier = kehillah_banned_books_1_modifier years = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:kehillah_lib_banned_count > 0
			has_variable = kehillah_yeshiva_fame
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = kehillah_yeshiva_fame
			subtract = {
				value = var:kehillah_lib_banned_count
				multiply = kehillah_lib_banned_fame_loss
			}
		}
		clamp_variable = { name = kehillah_yeshiva_fame min = 0 max = kehillah_yeshiva_fame_max }
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Standing (spec section 3). Rite scope unless stated. $KEY$ is a work id.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

# Scope: none needed. The global counters the gates read.
kehillah_sefer_ensure_counters_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_$KEY$_masters } }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_$KEY$_masters value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_$KEY$_approbations value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_$KEY$_taught value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_$KEY$_citations value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_$KEY$_commentaries value = 0 }
	}
	# 2026-11-11: the sermon and changed-minds counters of the Authoritative
	# gates; set here, for every work, so older saves have them too.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_$KEY$_preached } }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_$KEY$_preached value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_$KEY$_minds } }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_$KEY$_minds value = 0 }
	}
}

# Scope: any. Add 1 to a work's global counter ($COUNTER$: masters,
# approbations, taught, citations or commentaries).
kehillah_sefer_bump_counter_effect = {
	kehillah_sefer_ensure_counters_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ }
	change_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_$KEY$_$COUNTER$ add = 1 }
}

kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_standing_$KEY$ } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = faith.main_rite }
				faith.main_rite ?= { has_variable = kehillah_standing_$KEY$ }
			}
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_standing_$KEY$ value = faith.main_rite.var:kehillah_standing_$KEY$ }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_reception_$KEY$ value = faith.main_rite.var:kehillah_reception_$KEY$ }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_standing_$KEY$ value = kehillah_lib_baseline_$KEY$ }
			clamp_variable = { name = kehillah_standing_$KEY$ min = kehillah_lib_floor_$KEY$ max = kehillah_lib_ceiling_$KEY$ }
			set_variable = {
				name = kehillah_reception_$KEY$
				value = {
					value = var:kehillah_standing_$KEY$
					multiply = 10
					subtract = 5
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_ceiling_$KEY$ value = kehillah_lib_ceiling_$KEY$ }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_low_years_$KEY$ value = 0 }
	}
	kehillah_sefer_ensure_counters_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ }
}

kehillah_standing_recalc_work_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_ceiling_$KEY$ value = kehillah_lib_ceiling_$KEY$ }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_low_years_$KEY$ } }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_low_years_$KEY$ value = 0 }
	}
	# Presence on the shelves.
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_copies_$KEY$ >= kehillah_lib_third_of_libraries_value }
		change_variable = { name = kehillah_reception_$KEY$ add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_copies_$KEY$ < 1 }
		change_variable = { name = kehillah_reception_$KEY$ add = -1 }
	}
	# Neglect: with no new reader, approbation, teaching or citation for ten
	# years, reception drifts back toward the work's baseline.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_touched_$KEY$ }
			var:kehillah_reception_$KEY$ > {
				value = kehillah_lib_baseline_$KEY$
				multiply = 10
				subtract = 5
			}
		}
		change_variable = { name = kehillah_reception_$KEY$ add = -1 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { name = kehillah_reception_$KEY$ min = 0 max = 100 }

	# Ceiling and floor bind at once: a tenet newly prohibited caps the work.
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_standing_$KEY$ > kehillah_lib_ceiling_$KEY$ }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_standing_$KEY$ value = kehillah_lib_ceiling_$KEY$ }
	}
	# 2026-11-11 (one scale): an Anathema (0) is held below any floor until its
	# term runs out (kehillah_standing_next_gate_met_trigger).
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:kehillah_standing_$KEY$ > 0
			var:kehillah_standing_$KEY$ < kehillah_lib_floor_$KEY$
		}
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_standing_$KEY$ value = kehillah_lib_floor_$KEY$ }
	}

	set_variable = {
		name = kehillah_standing_target
		value = {
			value = var:kehillah_reception_$KEY$
			divide = 10
			floor = yes
			add = 1
		}
	}
	clamp_variable = { name = kehillah_standing_target min = kehillah_lib_floor_$KEY$ max = kehillah_lib_ceiling_$KEY$ }

	if = {
		limit = {
			var:kehillah_standing_target > var:kehillah_standing_$KEY$
			kehillah_standing_next_gate_met_trigger = { KEY = $KEY$ }
		}
		change_variable = { name = kehillah_standing_$KEY$ add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_low_years_$KEY$ value = 0 }
		save_scope_as = kehillah_standing_rite
		kehillah_standing_announce_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ DIRECTION = rise }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_standing_target < var:kehillah_standing_$KEY$ }
		change_variable = { name = kehillah_low_years_$KEY$ add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:kehillah_low_years_$KEY$ >= 5 }
			change_variable = { name = kehillah_standing_$KEY$ add = -1 }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_low_years_$KEY$ value = 0 }
			save_scope_as = kehillah_standing_rite
			kehillah_standing_announce_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ DIRECTION = fall }
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_low_years_$KEY$ value = 0 }
	}
	remove_variable = kehillah_standing_target

	# A controversy over this work (spec section 6.4).
	kehillah_machloket_yearly_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ }
}

# Scope: a rite (scope:kehillah_standing_rite). Tells a living player
# author, and players of the rite who hold a copy, that a work changed tier.
kehillah_standing_announce_effect = {
	# 2026-11-11: those who reviewed it in this rite share in its rise or fall.
	kehillah_review_stakes_$DIRECTION$_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_$KEY$_author ?= { is_alive = yes is_ai = no } }
		global_var:kehillah_wk_$KEY$_author = {
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_sefer_named_work value = flag:$KEY$ }
			send_interface_message = {
				type = msg_kehillah_sefer
				title = kehillah_sefer_msg_standing_$DIRECTION$_t
				desc = kehillah_sefer_msg_standing_$DIRECTION$_d
				left_icon = this
			}
		}
	}
}

# Scope: a character. Add reception for $KEY$ in his rite ($AMOUNT$ may be
# negative). Canon works carry no reception and are skipped.
kehillah_standing_add_reception_effect = {
	rite ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_standing_ready } }
			kehillah_standing_seed_rite_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = kehillah_reception_$KEY$ }
			change_variable = { name = kehillah_reception_$KEY$ add = $AMOUNT$ }
			clamp_variable = { name = kehillah_reception_$KEY$ min = 0 max = 100 }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_touched_$KEY$ value = yes days = 3650 }
		}
	}
}

# Scope: a faith. Every Jewish rite of it, seeded and recalculated.
kehillah_standing_yearly_faith_effect = {
	every_faith_rite = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_standing_ready } }
			kehillah_standing_seed_rite_effect = yes
		}
		kehillah_standing_yearly_rite_effect = yes
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. The reader (spec section 4.1), from kehillah_study_specific_work_
# effect. Scope: the reader; var:kehillah_study_torah_last_result holds
# 0 failed, 1 first mastery, 2 successful reread, 3 failed reread.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

kehillah_sefer_after_study_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_study_torah_last_result = 1 }
		kehillah_sefer_work_tenets_$KEY$_effect = yes
		# 2026-11-11: a Machshavah book may change the reader's mind.
		kehillah_minds_after_mastery_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ }
		# 2026-11-11: a player may set his name to it (a haskamah).
		kehillah_review_offer_haskamah_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ }
		kehillah_sefer_bump_counter_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ COUNTER = masters }
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_lib_canon_$KEY$ = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					# 2026-11-08: or any Karaite (Karaites have no clergy).
					kehillah_rabbi_or_karaite_trigger = yes
					learning >= 15
				}
				kehillah_standing_add_reception_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ AMOUNT = kehillah_reception_renowned_mastery_value }
			}
			else = {
				kehillah_standing_add_reception_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ AMOUNT = kehillah_reception_mastery_value }
			}
		}
		# Piety follows the work's standing in the reader's own rite
		# (2026-11-11 one scale: Authoritative and canon; Esteemed; Rejected, Contested).
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ >= 8 }
			add_piety = kehillah_sefer_piety_venerated_value
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ >= 7 }
			add_piety = kehillah_sefer_piety_classic_value
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ >= 2
				kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ <= 3
			}
			add_piety = kehillah_sefer_piety_suspect_value
		}
		# Remember a book written in this campaign, so a reader can gloss it.
		if = {
			limit = { exists = global_var:kehillah_wk_$KEY$_author }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_sefer_last_read_authored value = flag:$KEY$ }
		}
		# Personal tenets fit or chafe.
		kehillah_sefer_work_fit_$KEY$_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { var:kehillah_sefer_fit = 1 }
			add_learning_lifestyle_xp = 25
			if = {
				limit = { is_playable_character = yes }
				change_spiritual_fulfillment = miniscule_spiritual_fulfillment_value
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:kehillah_sefer_fit = -1 }
			add_stress = minor_stress_gain
		}
		remove_variable = kehillah_sefer_fit
		# Reading against one's own rite.
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_sefer_work_heterodox_$KEY$_trigger = yes }
			add_character_modifier = { modifier = kehillah_heterodox_reader_modifier years = 10 }
		}
	}
	# A Banned or Anathema work: any reading is an offence.
	if = {
		limit = {
			kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ <= 1
			NOT = { var:kehillah_study_torah_last_result = 3 }
		}
		add_piety = kehillah_sefer_piety_banned_value
		# 2026-11-11 cherem track: and it counts toward a ban on the reader.
		kehillah_cherem_read_forbidden_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ }
	}
	# The Tanakh and the Talmuds never wear out: a successful reading counts
	# toward the current round of its corpus, and a reread of canon pays a
	# Talmud Torah reader as fully as a first mastery.
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				var:kehillah_study_torah_last_result = 1
				var:kehillah_study_torah_last_result = 2
			}
		}
		kehillah_sefer_work_corpus_$KEY$_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:kehillah_study_torah_last_result = 2
			kehillah_lib_canon_$KEY$ >= 9
			kehillah_talmud_torah_follower_trigger = yes
		}
		add_piety = {
			value = kehillah_talmud_torah_first_mastery_piety
			subtract = kehillah_talmud_torah_repeat_mastery_piety
		}
	}
}

# Scope: the reader. Learn one tenet from a book (literal $TENET$).
kehillah_sefer_teach_tenet_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_playable_character = yes
			NOT = { knows_tenet = $TENET$ }
		}
		add_known_tenet = $TENET$
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:$TENET$ } } }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:$TENET$ }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { faith.religion = religion:judaism_religion }
		faith = {
			change_tenet_popularity = { target = tenet:$TENET$ change = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Scope: the reader. Teach the tenet an authored work's slot records
# (global_var:kehillah_wk_<slot>_tenet_<a|b>, an index in kehillah_sefer_
# tenet_index below).
kehillah_sefer_teach_dynamic_tenet_effect = {
	if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_$SLOT$_tenet_$WHICH$ = 1 } kehillah_sefer_teach_tenet_effect = { TENET = tenet_talmud_torah } }
	else_if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_$SLOT$_tenet_$WHICH$ = 2 } kehillah_sefer_teach_tenet_effect = { TENET = tenet_baalei_hamiqra } }
	else_if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_$SLOT$_tenet_$WHICH$ = 3 } kehillah_sefer_teach_tenet_effect = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah } }
	else_if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_$SLOT$_tenet_$WHICH$ = 4 } kehillah_sefer_teach_tenet_effect = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_emunah_temimah } }
	else_if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_$SLOT$_tenet_$WHICH$ = 5 } kehillah_sefer_teach_tenet_effect = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_pesak } }
	else_if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_$SLOT$_tenet_$WHICH$ = 6 } kehillah_sefer_teach_tenet_effect = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_pilpul } }
	else_if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_$SLOT$_tenet_$WHICH$ = 7 } kehillah_sefer_teach_tenet_effect = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_geonut } }
	else_if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_$SLOT$_tenet_$WHICH$ = 8 } kehillah_sefer_teach_tenet_effect = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_minhag_avoteinu } }
	else_if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_$SLOT$_tenet_$WHICH$ = 9 } kehillah_sefer_teach_tenet_effect = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_avelei_tziyon } }
	else_if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_$SLOT$_tenet_$WHICH$ = 10 } kehillah_sefer_teach_tenet_effect = { TENET = tenet_esotericism } }
	else_if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_$SLOT$_tenet_$WHICH$ = 11 } kehillah_sefer_teach_tenet_effect = { TENET = tenet_asceticism } }
	else_if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_$SLOT$_tenet_$WHICH$ = 12 } kehillah_sefer_teach_tenet_effect = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_kiddush_hashem } }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Rounds and the siyum (spec section 5.3). Scope: the reader.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

kehillah_sefer_round_progress_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_round_$CORPUS$_read target = flag:$KEY$ } } }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_round_$CORPUS$_read target = flag:$KEY$ }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_sefer_round_complete_$CORPUS$_trigger = yes }
		kehillah_sefer_siyum_effect = { CORPUS = $CORPUS$ }
	}
}

kehillah_sefer_siyum_effect = {
	clear_variable_list = kehillah_round_$CORPUS$_read
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_round_$CORPUS$ } }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_round_$CORPUS$ value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = kehillah_round_$CORPUS$ add = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_siyum_corpus value = flag:$CORPUS$ }
	# The layer this round opened, capped by what the reader can reach.
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_siyum_layer value = var:kehillah_round_$CORPUS$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = kehillah_siyum_layer min = 1 max = 4 }
	kehillah_sefer_cap_layer_$CORPUS$_effect = yes
	trigger_event = kehillah_sefer.0010
}

# Talmud layers: 2 needs Rashi on the Talmud written, 3 the Tosafot, 4
# Talmudics depth (spec section 5.3).
kehillah_sefer_cap_layer_bavli_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_talmud_written } }
		clamp_variable = { name = kehillah_siyum_layer min = 1 max = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_tosafot_written } }
		clamp_variable = { name = kehillah_siyum_layer min = 1 max = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = talmudics value >= 65 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { name = kehillah_siyum_layer min = 1 max = 3 }
	}
}

kehillah_sefer_cap_layer_yerushalmi_effect = {
	kehillah_sefer_cap_layer_bavli_effect = yes
}

# Tanakh layers: Derash needs a midrash mastered; Sod needs the hidden
# Torah known.
kehillah_sefer_cap_layer_tanakh_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_genesis_rabbah }
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_mekhilta }
				}
			}
		}
		clamp_variable = { name = kehillah_siyum_layer min = 1 max = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:tenet_esotericism } }
			NOT = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_esotericism }
		}
		clamp_variable = { name = kehillah_siyum_layer min = 1 max = 3 }
	}
}

# Scope: the reader, in kehillah_sefer.0010's immediate block.
kehillah_sefer_siyum_rewards_effect = {
	add_piety = kehillah_siyum_piety_value
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_talmud_torah_follower_trigger = yes }
		add_piety = { value = kehillah_siyum_piety_value divide = 2 }
	}
	add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
	add_learning_lifestyle_xp = kehillah_siyum_learning_xp_value
	if = {
		limit = { is_playable_character = yes }
		change_spiritual_fulfillment = minor_spiritual_fulfillment_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait }
		if = {
			limit = { var:kehillah_siyum_corpus = flag:tanakh }
			if = {
				limit = { var:kehillah_siyum_layer >= 4 }
				add_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = hashkafa value = kehillah_siyum_track_xp_value }
			}
			else = {
				add_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = parshanut value = kehillah_siyum_track_xp_value }
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = talmudics value = kehillah_siyum_track_xp_value }
		}
	}
	# 2026-11-08: a Toraic (Karaite) reader gains Religious Scholar.
	else = {
		kehillah_karaite_scholar_xp_effect = { XP = kehillah_siyum_track_xp_value }
	}
	# The community celebrates with him.
	if = {
		limit = { government_has_flag = government_is_kehillah }
		kehillah_change_pillar_effect = { PILLAR = stability AMOUNT = kehillah_siyum_stability_value }
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Faith-level tenet statuses (spec section 4.3 with Daniel's decision
# 6: Talmud Torah is the Oral Torah tenet Karaism prohibits). Faith scope
# only: rites differ only in their core tenets.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# The statuses themselves are history data (history/faiths/kehillah_baalei_
# hamiqra_faith_history.txt), so a new game starts with them and no message.
# This effect only brings a save started before that file had them into line;
# each faith block runs only while its marker status is missing.
#
# Scope: a faith. Vanilla's on_rite_updated (religion_on_actions.txt) sends
# every player of the faith a "Rite Changed" message for each status change.
# The on_action stays silent while the faith has ecumenical_council_ongoing,
# which only the Christian Ecumenical Council and Papal bulls otherwise read.
# Two days covers the changes; the variable then expires on its own.
kehillah_sefer_quiet_rite_messages_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ecumenical_council_ongoing } }
		set_variable = { name = ecumenical_council_ongoing value = yes days = 2 }
	}
}

kehillah_sefer_tenet_status_init_effect = {
	faith:rabbinic_faith ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { main_rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah status = permitted } } } }
			# No "Rite Changed" message per status: see the helper above.
			kehillah_sefer_quiet_rite_messages_effect = yes
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_baalei_hamiqra status = prohibited }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_hokhmah status = permitted }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_emunah_temimah status = permitted }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_pesak status = permitted }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_pilpul status = permitted }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_geonut status = permitted }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_minhag_avoteinu status = permitted }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_avelei_tziyon status = permitted }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_esotericism status = known }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_asceticism status = known }
		}
	}
	faith:kabarism ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { main_rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah status = known } } } }
			# No "Rite Changed" message per status: see the helper above.
			kehillah_sefer_quiet_rite_messages_effect = yes
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_baalei_hamiqra status = prohibited }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_hokhmah status = known }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_geonut status = known }
		}
	}
	faith:karaism ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { main_rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_geonut status = prohibited } } } }
			# No "Rite Changed" message per status: see the helper above.
			kehillah_sefer_quiet_rite_messages_effect = yes
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_talmud_torah status = prohibited }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_religious_legal_pronouncements status = prohibited }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_pilpul status = prohibited }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_geonut status = prohibited }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_hokhmah status = permitted }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_emunah_temimah status = known }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_pesak status = known }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_minhag_avoteinu status = known }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_avelei_tziyon status = permitted }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_esotericism status = known }
			set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_asceticism status = permitted }
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Landed libraries on temple holdings (Daniel's decision 1).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

# Scope: a province with a temple holding. Place the Beit Midrash building
# and register the temple barony as a library.
kehillah_lib_found_temple_library_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_building_or_higher = kehillah_temple_beit_midrash_01 } }
		add_building = kehillah_temple_beit_midrash_01
	}
	barony = {
		kehillah_lib_register_library_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_library_seeded } }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_library_seeded value = yes }
			kehillah_seed_landed_library_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

# Scope: a temple barony title just registered. A landed library starts
# with the Tanakh and, for a Rabbanite holder, the Mishnah and two Bavli
# orders; a Karaite holder's with Anan's code.
kehillah_seed_landed_library_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_is_karaite_library_trigger = yes }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_anan_sefer_hamitzvot }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_is_yerushalmi_library_trigger = yes }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mishnah }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_yerushalmi_zeraim }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_yerushalmi_moed }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_yerushalmi_nashim }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_yerushalmi_nezikin }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { kehillah_lib_is_haymanot_library_trigger = yes } }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mishnah }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_bavli_moed }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_bavli_nashim }
	}
	kehillah_lib_refresh_cache_effect = yes
}

# Scope: none. At game start (and once in an older save): every landed
# Jewish ruler of county tier or above with a Jewish-held temple holding
# in his realm gets a library there.
kehillah_lib_seed_landed_libraries_effect = {
	every_ruler = {
		limit = {
			kehillah_is_jewish_landed_ruler_trigger = yes
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
			is_independent_ruler = yes
		}
		save_scope_as = kehillah_landed_founder
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_realm_province = {
					has_holding_type = church_holding
					barony.holder ?= { faith.religion = religion:judaism_religion }
				}
			}
			ordered_realm_province = {
				limit = {
					has_holding_type = church_holding
					barony.holder ?= { faith.religion = religion:judaism_religion }
				}
				order_by = {
					value = 0
					if = { limit = { this = scope:kehillah_landed_founder.capital_province } add = 100 }
					if = { limit = { county = scope:kehillah_landed_founder.capital_county } add = 50 }
				}
				kehillah_lib_found_temple_library_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. The save, once (new games call it from game start, older saves from
# the yearly pulse).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
kehillah_sefer_migrate_save_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_sefer_v2_ready } }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_sefer_v2_ready value = yes }
		kehillah_sefer_tenet_status_init_effect = yes
		kehillah_sefer_mark_historical_works_effect = yes
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = kehillah_registered_communities
			limit = { exists = holder }
			kehillah_lib_register_library_effect = yes
		}
		kehillah_lib_seed_landed_libraries_effect = yes
		kehillah_sefer_seed_all_rites_effect = yes
		# Yeshivot that predate the Shas rule keep running (spec section 8).
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = kehillah_libraries
			limit = { holder ?= { kehillah_has_yeshiva_trigger = yes } }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_yeshiva_grandfathered value = yes }
		}
	}
	# 2026-11-10: Jewish adults' reading languages (Hebrew, Aramaic), once, with
	# its own flag so saves already past the block above get it too.
	kehillah_language_seed_effect = yes
	# 2026-11-11: standing on one scale (docs/spec/2026-11-11-standing-one-scale.md).
	# An older save's Classic, Authoritative and Venerated become Authoritative.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_standing_one_scale } }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_standing_one_scale value = yes }
		religion:judaism_religion = {
			every_faith = {
				every_faith_rite = {
					limit = { has_variable = kehillah_standing_ready }
					kehillah_standing_one_scale_rite_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# 2026-11-11: Talmudics books written before the docket had orders cover
	# Nezikin (docs/spec/2026-11-11-rulings-sermons-and-gates.md section 2).
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_din_sedarim_ready } }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_din_sedarim_ready value = yes }
		kehillah_din_seder_migrate_effect = yes
	}
	# 2026-11-11 (Daniel): to the Beta Israel and the Samaritans, the other
	# traditions' works are Obscure, not Banned or Rejected.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_standing_other_obscure } }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_standing_other_obscure value = yes }
		religion:judaism_religion = {
			every_faith = {
				every_faith_rite = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = kehillah_standing_ready
						kehillah_rite_rabbanite_trigger = no
						kehillah_rite_toric_trigger = no
					}
					kehillah_standing_other_faiths_obscure_rite_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

kehillah_sefer_seed_all_rites_effect = {
	religion:judaism_religion = {
		every_faith = {
			every_faith_rite = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_standing_ready } }
					kehillah_standing_seed_rite_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Scope: none. Once a year, from yearly_global_pulse.
kehillah_sefer_yearly_effect = {
	kehillah_sefer_migrate_save_effect = yes
	# 2026-11-10: books in an author's own tongue rise and fall with the royal
	# courts that speak it (Sefer languages), before ceilings are refreshed.
	kehillah_language_refresh_all_prestige_effect = yes
	religion:judaism_religion = {
		every_faith = {
			kehillah_standing_yearly_faith_effect = yes
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = kehillah_libraries
		limit = { exists = holder }
		kehillah_lib_yearly_library_effect = yes
	}
	kehillah_sefer_recycle_slots_effect = yes
	# 2026-11-11: scholars who oppose a new book may ban it unread.
	kehillah_review_yearly_unread_effect = yes
	# 2026-11-08 tenet mechanics (kehillah_tenet_effects.txt).
	kehillah_tenet_yearly_effect = yes
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Smaller helpers.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

# Scope: a judge with kehillah_sefer_judgeable built. Offer candidate $N$.
kehillah_sefer_pick_candidate_effect = {
	remove_variable = kehillah_sefer_cand_$N$
	if = {
		limit = { any_in_list = { variable = kehillah_sefer_judgeable } }
		random_in_list = {
			variable = kehillah_sefer_judgeable
			save_scope_as = kehillah_sefer_cand_scope_$N$
		}
		remove_list_variable = { name = kehillah_sefer_judgeable target = scope:kehillah_sefer_cand_scope_$N$ }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_sefer_cand_$N$ value = scope:kehillah_sefer_cand_scope_$N$ }
	}
}

# Scope: a student, after mastering a work at a yeshiva (kehillah_yeshiva_
# record_work_effect, whose WORK has no flag: prefix).
kehillah_sefer_after_yeshiva_mastery_effect = {
	kehillah_sefer_work_tenets_$KEY$_effect = yes
	# 2026-11-11: a Machshavah book may change the student's mind, and he may
	# give a living book a haskamah.
	kehillah_minds_after_mastery_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ }
	kehillah_review_offer_haskamah_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ }
	kehillah_sefer_bump_counter_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ COUNTER = masters }
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_canon_$KEY$ = 0 }
		kehillah_standing_add_reception_effect = { KEY = $KEY$ AMOUNT = kehillah_reception_mastery_value }
	}
	kehillah_sefer_work_corpus_$KEY$_effect = yes
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. The Libraries map mode (spec section 2.5). Every barony in the base
# colour, then each library's seat by tradition: a yeshiva seat in gold, a
# sealed library in red. Each seat is tagged for the map's hover text.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
kehillah_paint_libraries_map_effect = {
	every_county = {
		every_county_province = {
			remove_variable = kehillah_map_library
			barony ?= {
				set_color_from_title = title:d_kehillah_mapcolor_rite_base
			}
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = kehillah_libraries
		limit = {
			exists = holder
			exists = var:kehillah_library_seat
		}
		save_scope_as = kehillah_paint_library
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = kehillah_library_sealed }
			title:d_kehillah_mapcolor_lib_sealed = { save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_map_color }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_variable = kehillah_landed_yeshiva
					holder = { kehillah_has_yeshiva_trigger = yes }
				}
			}
			title:d_kehillah_mapcolor_lib_yeshiva = { save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_map_color }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { kehillah_lib_is_karaite_library_trigger = yes }
			title:d_kehillah_mapcolor_lib_karaite = { save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_map_color }
		}
		else = {
			title:d_kehillah_mapcolor_lib_rabbanite = { save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_map_color }
		}
		var:kehillah_library_seat = {
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_map_library value = scope:kehillah_paint_library }
			barony ?= {
				set_color_from_title = scope:kehillah_lib_map_color
			}
		}
	}
}

# Scope: the player (debug). Log the standing of $KEY$ in his rite.
kehillah_sefer_debug_log_tier_effect = {
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ = 0 } debug_log = "kehillah_sefer_v2_debug STANDING_IS_0" }
	else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ = 1 } debug_log = "kehillah_sefer_v2_debug STANDING_IS_1" }
	else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ = 2 } debug_log = "kehillah_sefer_v2_debug STANDING_IS_2" }
	else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ = 3 } debug_log = "kehillah_sefer_v2_debug STANDING_IS_3" }
	else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ = 4 } debug_log = "kehillah_sefer_v2_debug STANDING_IS_4" }
	else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ = 5 } debug_log = "kehillah_sefer_v2_debug STANDING_IS_5" }
	else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ = 6 } debug_log = "kehillah_sefer_v2_debug STANDING_IS_6" }
	else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ = 7 } debug_log = "kehillah_sefer_v2_debug STANDING_IS_7" }
	else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ = 8 } debug_log = "kehillah_sefer_v2_debug STANDING_IS_8" }
	else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ = 9 } debug_log = "kehillah_sefer_v2_debug STANDING_IS_9" }
	else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ = 10 } debug_log = "kehillah_sefer_v2_debug STANDING_IS_10" }
	else_if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_$KEY$ = 11 } debug_log = "kehillah_sefer_v2_debug STANDING_IS_11" }
}
